title: Packing System for Short Trips
summary: A repeatable packing template with one-bag constraints and weather-based swaps.

blocks.alt: Travel bag illustration for packing system post

blocks.value: Start with one base list: clothing, hygiene, documents, and tech. Avoid deciding from scratch every trip.
Use a strict item cap and replace instead of adding. This keeps luggage stable and avoids overpacking.
Make weather swaps the only variable: outerwear in, extra layers out. The system stays predictable and fast.
